mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and is rising, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in residential construction permits signals weakening housing demand as a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer price index and decline in federal funds rate signals policy response to rising inflation, causing temporary market uncertainty that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS declining fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
